description: Holds each of 26 futures markets while its 50-day average is above its 200-day average; a market in a downtrend is held as cash. Equal slots, rebalanced monthly. Backtested on FinzData futures: each market is its front-month contract rolled on the FinzData roll calendar, as an excess-return index (no interest on collateral), 5 bps costs per trade, re-run free on full history.
title: Futures trend · 50/200-day moving average · 26 markets
